label: Xiaomi 13 smartphone
description: Xiaomi 13 — 6.36-inch Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 flagship, Wi-Fi 6E (2x2) and 5G sub-6 GHz; USB-C 2.0 port with OTG Ethernet support.
notes: Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5/6 GHz) — Xiaomi's spec page lists Wi-Fi 7/6E/6 support on the platform, but shipping firmware behaves as 6E; model it as 6E. Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz only (no mmWave), dual-SIM with eSIM on global SKUs. USB-C is USB 2.0, so Ethernet via OTG adapter tops out around 100M though it is declared 1G here for topology purposes.
